capabilities: fetch LeetCode problems by ID into the workspace
write, auto-save, and execute solutions in an embedded code editor
request Socratic AI hints, edge case analysis, and dry runs
diagram data structures and architectures on Canvas
extras: Not yet approved for the Obsidian community plugin store, so it must be installed manually from repository releases. AI features are bring-your-own-key: the user supplies API key, base URL, and model ID.
problem: Practicing algorithms means switching between a browser for problems, an IDE for coding, and notes, with no single connected workspace.

relations.evidence: Enter a LeetCode problem ID to instantly fetch the description, constraints, and default test cases
connect to OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Google Gemini, or even local offline models like Ollama
relations.plugin: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Google Gemini, Ollama

summary: LeetCode practice workspace that fetches problems by ID, runs code in an embedded editor, and provides Socratic AI hints that guide without spoiling.
